content:
**Gunslinger Expert** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

+3 max Onslaught stacks. +1% ranged weak spot damage per Onslaught stack.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | +1% ranged weak spot damage per Onslaught stack, +3 max stacks. | 0031AEFD | 

Before Update 58 Gunslinger Expert was called "Expert Gunslinger," and it provided 10%/15%/20% more damage to non-automatic pistols per rank.
